title: Automate your sales pipeline
description: A free AI browser that finds leads, researches accounts, transcribes your calls, and follows up. Like a sales hire who never lets a lead go cold.
introduction: Picture a sales hire who finds the right companies, reads up on every account before your call, writes the follow-up while you're still saying goodbye, and never lets a lead go cold. That's what Strawberry can become for your team.

ChatGPT and Claude can explain how to prospect. Strawberry does the prospecting. It's a free browser with an AI companion built in, working inside LinkedIn, your inbox, and your CRM, logged in as you.

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Strawberry is free to download. Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

skill.context: Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing to hand over.

sections.title: Find leads that fit, with proof

blocks.text: Describe your best customers, or let Strawberry learn them from your website and CRM. It digs through LinkedIn, niche directories, job posts, and funding news, and hands you each company with the reason it fits and a link to check.

demo.prompt: Find 30 Nordic fintechs that just raised a Series A and are hiring their first sales lead

items.context: Get a first sample of prospects, each with a reason it fits and the source behind it.

blocks.text: Press record in Strawberry and your call is transcribed, with no bot joining the meeting. By the time you hang up, the follow-up email, the CRM notes, and the next steps are drafted and waiting for a quick check.

blocks.text: Who's in the room, what changed at their company, and what you talked about last time, in one short brief. Strawberry also helps you pick the strongest points to lead with.

sections.title: Outreach that sounds like you, on autopilot

blocks.text: Strawberry learns your voice from your sent emails and writes each message for the person reading it. It runs the follow-ups from a simple sheet and stops the moment someone replies. Nothing sends until you say so.

sections.title: Spot buyers already in your product

blocks.text: Some of your best leads already have an account. A weekly Routine checks your user data for accounts behaving like buyers and hands you each one with the reason it stood out.

demo.title: High-intent accounts
steps: Compared with last month's paying customers

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: A chat window can only work with what you paste into it. Strawberry works where your leads actually are.

items: It uses LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, and your CRM while you're logged in, with no exports or API keys.
It reads dozens of pages at once instead of clicking through one tab at a time, and paces itself on LinkedIn to keep your account safe.
Every tab it opens is a real tab. Watch it work, or take over whenever you like.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

items: Enrich a list you already have with decision-makers, emails, and company size.
Keep the pipeline healthy: stale leads, duplicates, and contacts who changed jobs.
Create a Slack channel for every new deal, with the right people already in it.
Pin a live pipeline dashboard as a tab.
Make a one-pager or a short deck for a specific account, in your brand.

blocks.text: Once something works for you, it works for everyone. Save your method as a team skill and every rep's companion sources, preps, and follows up the same way. Share one sales companion and it brings everything it has learned about your customers along.

Put the steady parts on Routines and the pipeline gets worked every morning, whether or not anyone remembered to. It stops feeling like a tool and starts feeling like a colleague who joined the sales team and never drops a thread.
